definition: means the period of gap that occurs at the end of the existing policy term/installment premium due date, when the premium due for renewal on a given policy or installment premium due is not paid on or before the premium renewal date or grace period.
plain: A gap between one policy period ending and the next beginning, because the premium was not paid in time.
whyItMatters: The practical damage is the loss of continuity credit. Waiting periods you have already served can reset, and the insurer can re-underwrite you at your current age and health — which is a materially worse position than the one you were in the week before.
